title: code_index.change_signature response
description: The shared code_index edit envelope (the `rename_symbol` response shape) plus this operation's refusal tags and fields. `applied` carries the per-file edits and every rewritten call site; with `dry_run` nothing was written, and `applied: false` with `failed_paths_with_reasons` means some writes failed after every plan passed. Every other tag is a refusal that wrote nothing, with the blocking locations in `sites` and the reason in `details`. A request that does not fit the declaration (an unknown `from`, a new parameter without `call_value` or `default`, an unchanged list) raises an invalid-parameter error instead of returning a result.

result.description: `ambiguous_symbol`: several declarations match the seed, another free function shares the name, or a call by that name cannot reach this declaration; candidates are in `warnings`. `conflict`: renaming a parameter would capture an existing name in the body. `error`: the declaration's parameter list cannot be rewritten (a comment inside it, keyword-only markers). `parameter_in_use`: the body still uses a removed parameter. `value_reference`: the function is used as a value. `unsupported_call_site`: a call passes a spread, splat, or an argument count that cannot be remapped. `overrides_present`: the function is a trait, interface, or overridden method.

touched_files.description: One entry per rewritten file. Empty on refusals.

conflicts.description: On `conflict`: where a renamed parameter would capture an existing name.

warnings.description: On `ambiguous_symbol`: one `{path, line, kind}` candidate per competing declaration or call. Empty otherwise.

match_count.description: Total edits across `touched_files`: the header, renamed body uses, and call-site argument lists.

fallback_suggestion.description: Present only on `unsupported_language`: the text-edit path to fall back to.

call_sites_updated.description: Number of call sites rewritten (or planned, on a dry run).

sites.description: On `applied`: every rewritten call site. On a refusal: every blocking location.

parameters_before.description: Each current parameter, excluding the receiver. Present on every result after the declaration was read, refusals included; empty before that.

parameters_after.description: Source text of each parameter in the new header, receiver first. Empty on refusals.
